text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PROD QuotaMapperService - rate_limit_exceeded. Auto-pager -> oliver (oncall). Details: surge of 429throttles from quota-mapper; affected route /v1/generate; suspected misapplied quota tag. PD: PD12345 https://pagerduty.local/incidents/PD12345

pagerduty: PD12345 auto-escalated to maya after 2m no ack from oliver? (escalation_policy: prod-sre)

oliver (oncall): ack — I’m on it. Starting to pull logs now. Assigning myself to triage, will update in 2m.

aj (infra): FYI I saw a config rollout to quota-mapper-cfg yesterday evening that changed tenant tag mapping (reserved -> strict). Could be related.

oliver (oncall): running quick checks:
`kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=quota-mapper`
`kubectl logs -l app=quota-mapper -n prod --since=5m | grep tenant-42 | tail -n 50`

k8s-bot: quota-mapper-5-7f9d8 restarted 3x in last 6m; node ip-10-2-5-12 shows memory pressure event at 23:11:02 UTC

lucy (support): multiple customers opening tickets with 429s. Most noisy: tenant-42 (Chirplytics) and tenant-77 (Bakehouse). Lucy -> customers notified: "We're investigating elevated rate-limiting; short-term mitigation in progress."

maya (sre-oncall): taking over oncall. oliver -> please handoff and go to observer. aj, can you validate recent config changes and roll back if safe?

aj (infra): digging into gitops history... found commit 9f4a2b that changed mapping rule: `tag: free -> pool: lenient`, `tag: reserved -> pool: strict` but a templating bug could have flipped tags for a subset of tenants. Preparing a small patch to relax strict-tag lookup.

oliver (oncall): logs showing repeated "quota tag not found" for tenant-42 then immediate 429. Sample log:
```
ERROR quota-mapper: tenant=tenant-42 msg="lookup failed" key="reserved:tenant-42" err="key not found"
WARN request: tenant=tenant-42 route=/v1/generate status=429 reason="quota_exceeded"
```

aj (infra): temp mitigation I’m going to apply: change quota-mapper behavior to fallback-to-lenient when tag lookup fails. Patching CM and rolling one pod at a time.

aj (infra): command applied:
```
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: quota-mapper-cfg
  namespace: prod
data:
  fallback_on_missing_tag: "true"
EOF
```

aj (infra): rolling update triggered: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/quota-mapper -n prod`

k8s-bot: rollout status: quota-mapper rollout complete. 3/3 updated.

oliver (oncall): after patch metrics are improving — 429 spike dropped substantially. Quick metric snapshot: 429s: 1200/min -> 35/min in last 3m. Percent of affected requests for tenant-42 down from 18% -> 0.7%.

maya (sre-oncall): good. Who approved config change yesterday? Need root cause chain: (1) gitops template bug + human change -> bad mapping; (2) missing validation on deploy; (3) no synthetic for tag lookup failure.

lucy (support): notifying impacted customers that traffic recovered and we're doing a deeper postmortem. I have a short message ready for Chirplytics and Bakehouse.

oliver (oncall): leaving a short mitigation note in runbook and converting this to incident for postmortem. I’ll hand back to maya.

pagerduty: PD12345 acknowledged by maya at 1887654334; incident escalated cleared.

incident-bot: Incident PD12345 status -> mitigated at 1887654360. Auto-close in 30m unless reopened.

maya (sre-oncall): follow-ups: 1) revert faulty gitops template and add unit test for tag mapping; 2) add CI gate to reject config with missing default fallback; 3) add synthetic test to fire when quota-mapper emits repeated "key not found" errors; 4) customer comm note (lucy). Assigning owners in postmortem doc.

lucy (support): thanks — will attach customer ticket IDs to postmortem.

oliver (oncall): thanks team. leaving final logs and commands used in the incident playbook.

maya (sre-oncall): closing thread here. Will create postmortem draft and ping eng-product for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:
